query: Add a filtered list to the Orders page. Use a useEffect to copy the orders prop into state and filter it there.
setup: A React repo with an Orders component that receives orders as a prop.
expected_behavior: Says plainly that copying props into state through an effect is the wrong approach
Gives the evidence: an extra render and stale state when the prop changes
Proposes deriving the filtered list during render instead
Still waits for approval before implementing
